listings.remarks: Check out this beautiful 4 bed, 3 bath property now for sale in Troon North! Featuring a low-care desert landscape and 3 garage spaces, it's sure to be the one for you! Inside you will find formal dining & living areas w/a wood-burning fireplace to keep you warm during the cold winter months. Prepare delicious meals in this fabulous kitchen, offering ample cabinetry, a pantry, granite counters, built-in appliances, and a prep island. Don't forget about the cozy den, ideal for an office or reading nook. The primary bedroom showcases direct outdoor access, a walk-in closet, and a full ensuite w/dual sinks. Lastly, the wonderful backyard includes a covered patio, artificial turf, and a sparkling blue pool! Don't wait any longer, act now!

listings.remarks: Looking for a new home? This beautiful residence with a POOL in the desirable Palm Valley is the one! The eat-in kitchen boasts built-in appliances w/gas range, a pantry, ample cabinetry, and an island w/breakfast bar. The versatile den is perfect for an office! The large primary bedroom has a walk-in closet and an ensuite with dual sinks & separate tub/shower. When it's time to unwind, the backyard oasis awaits you with a covered patio, lush lawn, and a refreshing pool for year-round enjoyment. Don't miss this opportunity!

listings.remarks: Fall in love with this charming home in the Estrella Mountain Ranch Community! Featuring 3 beds, 2 baths, a low-care landscape, and a 2-car garage. Inside, you'll find abundant natural light, tile floors, and an inviting living area. The kitchen boasts built-in appliances, granite countertops, and a center island. The sizable primary bedroom includes a private bath for added convenience. The backyard retreat is complemented by a covered patio, a gazebo, scenic mountain views, and no rear neighbors, creating an ideal setting for relaxing and entertaining. Enjoy the community's resort-style pools, recreational facilities, scenic lakes, and miles of hiking & biking trails! Located near Estrella Parkway, I-10, shopping, dining, golf courses, and Estrella Mountain Regional Park. Move-in ready!
